column1: # Suhalla Gate checkpoint: travel papers, Colosso guards, Iodem's arrival and the wounded soldiers.

column3:
Only travelers with
proper papers may pass.
Without them, turn back.{page_break}Show your papers, or
leave this passage
at once.{end_wait}
Are you heading to\nBabi Lighthouse?{end_now}

I never ask why Babi
has ordered me to guard
this passage.{page_break}A soldier follows
orders. I do as I am
told.{end_wait}

I wonder if Colosso
has ended for the year...{page_break}I wish I could have
seen it. Perhaps
next year...{end_wait}
What is the meaning\nof this!?{end_wait}

Oh...{pause_20_skippable} There's no use.
I don't think I can
stand.{page_break}Please, send help from
Babi Lighthouse when
you reach it.{end_wait}

It's a shame a Colosso
victor should end up
like this...{page_break}When I find them,
I'll make them answer
for what they've done!{end_wait}

Damn it... I can't bear
to let Iodem see me
like this...{page_break}I'd rather crawl into
a hole and hide.{end_wait}

I thought I was dead!
I'm lucky to be alive
at all...{page_break}Those strange men with
wild hair... They were
far too powerful.{end_wait}
Uh...{pause_20_skippable} Is...{pause_20_skippable}\nIs that Iodem...?{end_wait}
What happened here\nat the gate?{end_wait}
A group of strangers\ncame... They had no\npapers, but tried to pass...{end_wait}
I-Io{pause_20_skippable}dem...{end_wait}
We tried to stop them...\nbut they were{pause_20_skippable}\ntoo strong for us!{end_wait}
They{pause_20_skippable} wielded strange\npowers...{pause_20_skippable} We were\nno match for them.{end_wait}
It had to be {actor_name:5}!{end_now}
Yeah... No one else\ncould have done this.{end_wait}
You know your own enemy,\nIodem. Who else could\nhave done this?{end_wait}
Once we find {actor_name:7},\nwe must hunt down the\nmonsters who did this.{end_wait}
We must reach Babi\nLighthouse at once!{end_wait}
Yes{pause_20_skippable}, but we cannot\nleave the soldiers\nhere...{end_wait}
We're all right.{pause_20_skippable} Don't\nworry about us! Go\nafter them{pause_20_skippable}, please...{end_wait}
But we can't just...{end_wait}
We lost the fight, but\nwe will{pause_20_skippable} survive...\n{pause_20_skippable}Now go!{end_wait}
If they've done anything\nto the lighthouse...\nIt would be our...{end_wait}
He's right. We've got\nto stop them!{end_wait}
We're going after them,\naren't we, {actor_name:1}?{end_wait}
